name: Enterprise Product, Offering and Roadmap
constraints: WM-ECO-021 owns only recipient-specific proposal prices and terms and references the applicable Offering and Price Plan versions.
Roadmap Item profiles WM-ACT-008 as non-contractual planning intent with schedule, confidence, version and realization links.
Roadmap Item never proves availability, release, entitlement, task completion, delivery or contractual obligation.
Availability requires an authoritative Offering or release record and delivery requires an act record.
Product survives tariff, market withdrawal and roadmap-confidence changes.
Price Plan remains an Offering component until independent external or regulatory mastership is demonstrated.
